title: Number-Theoretic Ultrametric Foundations: A Unified p-adic Framework for Error-Correcting Code Classification
description: A unified framework connecting p-adic valuation theory, Mahler spectral expansions, Kodaira-Neron fiber classification, and the Amice transform to the classification of quantum error-correcting codes. v1.1: Fixed math rendering — PDF now built with Pandoc+XeLaTeX for proper mathematical typography.
